title: IELTS Grammar Practice - IELTS Grammar - Conditionals
subject: IELTS Grammar

questions.q: If I ______ you, I would accept the offer immediately.
questions.explain: In the second conditional, 'were' is used for all subjects (including 'I') to express a hypothetical situation.
questions.subject: IELTS Grammar

questions.q: Had I known about the traffic, I ______ left earlier.
questions.explain: This is a Third Conditional inversion. 'Had I known' means 'If I had known', so the result clause requires 'would have' + past participle.
questions.subject: IELTS Grammar
